method: self-distillation: teacher = base model + Humanizer skill (embedded mode); student prompt has no skill

filter.code: fact literals (numbers, currency, capitalised names) present as whole tokens; protected spans verbatim; no new numbers/urls (url trailing punctuation ignored); length ratio in (0.3, 1.3); no preamble line; finish=stop. Hedges and negations are the judge's.
filter.note: checker tightened 2026-10-12 after the pack was built: 6 of 203 train rows came from samples the shipped checker would now reject (noun changed next to a number, e.g. '14 people' -> '14 participants'); the pack is unchanged until the next rebuild
